feeds.title: Baptist News Global
feeds.description: Baptist News Global is a reader-supported, independent news organization providing original and curated news, opinion and analysis about matters of faith. We cover the people, events and ideas that are shaping American religion and culture. We do so from a perspective that is Baptist in heritage and ecumenical in spirit.

feeds.title: SBC Voices
feeds.description: SBC Voices is a blog about issues that concern Southern Baptists and provides news and opinions. SBC Voices is a leading source for information, opinions, and discussion of matters of concern for the Southern Baptist Convention.

feeds.title: Paul Chappell
feeds.description: Dr. Paul Chappell is the senior pastor of the Lancaster Baptist Church and president of West Coast Baptist College in Lancaster, California. His biblical vision has led the church to become one of the most dynamic independent Baptist churches in the nation.

feeds.title: Albert Mohler
feeds.description: Dr. R. Albert Mohler Jr. serves as president of The Southern Baptist Theological Seminary. This blog is about Cultural commentary from a Biblical perspective.

feeds.title: Brentwood Baptist - News Articles Blog
feeds.description: Brentwood Baptist is a community of believers whose mission is to connect others to Jesus Christ through Worship, Discipleship, and Service.

feeds.title: Baptist Standard
feeds.description: Baptist news and opinions for Texas Baptists, Cooperative Baptist Fellowship, Southern Baptist Convention and more. Trusted Baptist news source since 1888.

feeds.title: Borrowed Light
feeds.description: In Christ, Husband, Father, Learner, Pastor at FBC Marionville, Writer, Author of Torn to Heal: God's Good Purpose in Suffering & The Seeds Project. That Christ may be the only boast of this generation.

feeds.title: MBC Pathway
feeds.description: Missouri & U.S. Baptist News & Christian News on churches, faith, ethics & policy, inspirational columns, global news & apologetics. The Pathway is the official news media of the Missouri Baptist Convention.

feeds.title: Baptist Joint Committee for Religious Liberty Blog
feeds.description: The Baptist Joint Committee for Religious Liberty's mission is to defend and extend God-given religious liberty for all, furthering the Baptist heritage that champions the principle that religion must be freely exercised, neither advanced nor inhibited by government.

feeds.title: The Alabama Baptist
feeds.description: The Alabama Baptist has its readers' Christian walk in mind, seeking to empower them to live out discipleship in their personal, professional and church life. It aims to equip them with resources and information and to do that with competence, compassion, fairness and dependability as a news source.

feeds.title: Baptist World Alliance
feeds.description: News updates from Baptist World Alliance, a global movement of Baptists sharing a common confession of faith in Jesus Christ bonded together by God's love to support, encourage and strengthen one another while proclaiming and living the Gospel of Jesus Christ in the power of the Holy Spirit before a lost and hurting world.

feeds.title: Reformed Baptist Blog
feeds.description: Get Pastoral Insights from a Reformed Baptist Perspective. The Reformed Baptist Blog seeks to maintain a pastoral focus, with a balance of teaching the Church. Reformed Baptist focuses on the Biblical basis for and the distinctiveness of Reformed Baptist Federalism. The blog also seeks to inform, especially within the Reformed Baptist community about matters of interest to them.

feeds.title: Baptist Message
feeds.description: 'Helping Louisiana Baptists Impact the World For Christ'. Since 1886 the Louisiana Baptist Message has provided news to inform, inspire and encourage your faith in Christ.

feeds.title: Baptist and Reflector
feeds.description: The Baptist and Reflector is the official newsjournal of the Tennessee Baptist Convention. Its beginnings can be traced back to 1835, making it one of the oldest Baptist papers in the Southern Baptist Convention.

feeds.title: CBFblog
feeds.description: This blog is an online community for Cooperative Baptists. A Christian network of individuals and churches partnering together to renew God's world. This place is designed with Fellowship people in mind. It's a place where people who are involved in, or interested in the Cooperative Baptist Fellowship can network, learn, and discuss.

feeds.title: Barnabas File
feeds.description: I consider myself an itinerant educator. My time is spent in encouraging and equipping ministers through my work with the Central Baptist Seminary and Pinnacle Leadership Associates.

feeds.title: Pastor's Pulse
feeds.description: Welcome to Emmanuel Baptist Church. In Emmanuel Baptist Church you will find a vibrant community committed to growing in the grace and knowledge of the Lord Jesus Christ.

feeds.title: Detroit Baptist Theological Seminary Blog
feeds.description: Detroit Baptist Theological Seminary is committed to glorifying God by training men to fulfill the Great Commission, read posts from the Seminary on their blog. Detroit Baptist Theological Seminary exists for the glory of God to serve local churches by shaping faithful men for the gospel ministry through the word of God.

feeds.title: Pastor Gabe
feeds.description: Gabriel Hughes is the associate pastor of First Baptist Church in Lindale, TX. He previously served as a senior pastor for 10 years before moving to Texas in partnership with Dr. Tom Buck and his ministry.

feeds.title: Cornerstone Baptist Church Orillia | Blogs
feeds.description: The Mission of Cornerstone Baptist Church, Orillia is the same mission shared by every Christ following church. It is the mission given to us by Jesus: 'Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptising them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, 20and teaching them to obey everything that I have commanded you.

feeds.title: Strand Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: Our church is part of a story—an ancient story of God, who loves the world so much that He gave his only Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have eternal life. ​We are witnesses to this amazing news in the community of Strand.​

feeds.title: Evergreen SGV - Pastor Cory's Blog
feeds.description: Evergreen Baptist Church of San Gabriel Valley's mission is to Love God, Love others and make a difference!

feeds.title: Vision Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: Vision Baptist Church is an independent Baptist church pastored by Austin Gardner. We are located in Alpharetta, GA, in the southern end of Forsyth County. We are a missions-minded church with a goal of fully honoring God and helping families draw closer to Him.

feeds.title: The Glory of His Grace
feeds.description: The Bible-Teaching Ministry of Henry Trocino, Jr.

feeds.title: Brad Hoffmann
feeds.description: A Baptist blog by Brad Hoffmann. He is passionate about assisting other ministry leaders in developing a personal self-care strategy for longevity in ministry.

feeds.title: Park Road Baptist Church - Still Christian for a Reason Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Park Road Baptist church blog - where we share thoughts and commentary on topics ranging from faith, to current events, to life. This is a progressive Baptist church that emphasizes independent thought, community service, social justice, and interfaith understanding.

feeds.title: Independent Baptist
feeds.description: A new website has been born with an old cause at its heart. Independent Baptist has been founded in an attempt to bring back the principles that lifted our movement in the 60's and 70's and that need to be revived in this day. We want to be a help and a blessing. Our prayer is that this will be part of a resurgence of strong Independent Baptist churches in our country.

feeds.title: 4Elect
feeds.description: Know and Love God and Live For His GloryWe exist to help you know, love and glorify God through the person and work of Jesus Christ and in the power of His Holy Spirit.

feeds.title: First Baptist Church Stephens
feeds.description: First Baptist Church is a loving community of believers in Jesus Christ. Our history goes back for about a century of serving Jesus in our community. We have exciting ministries for people of all ages, including youth and children.

feeds.title: Baptist21
feeds.description: Baptist21 is a pastor-led network that seeks to be a positive voice for the future, promoting the centrality of the gospel, the primacy of the local church, a focus on all nations, and Southern Baptist distinctives.

feeds.title: Baptist Press
feeds.description: Baptist Press is the official news service of the Southern Baptist Convention. Recognizing its role to serve the broader evangelical community, Baptist Press seeks to carry stories and report news that is of interest to numerous likeminded evangelical readers.Baptist Press provides news service to the 42 state Baptist papers.

feeds.title: Trinity Baptist Church Blog
feeds.description: We believe that Christian cooperation is not dependent upon organizational unification. We believe we are united as brothers in Christ with all others who are children of God by grace through faith in Our Lord Jesus Christ.Our process is a Spirit led, biblically based and felt-needs approach to ministry.
